Quotes / Wang Yangming / Q0463

English

Before you looked at this flower, it and your mind alike were still; when you come to look, its colors suddenly become clear.
Thinker Wang Yangming
School School of Mind
Source Instructions for Practical Living
Theme Mind
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Instructions for Practical Living, within the tradition of School of Mind. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of mind, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Wang Yangming's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
